description: Land Title Settlement Department -  Pitunugama, Udunuwara D/S Division,  Kandy District  - Cad. Map No. 320242 and others
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains multiple declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including detailed information about land ownership, extent, location, and encumbrances. The content appears in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette and focuses entirely on land registration and property rights, making it clearly fall under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4).
